title: Package flagged for reinstallation
description: packages.config declares a `requireReinstallation` flag that marks drifted restore state. Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `requireReinstallation` flag that marks drifted restore state.
remediation: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a `requireReinstallation` flag that marks drifted restore state.
limitation: It matches a `requireReinstallation` flag that marks drifted restore state in the parsed packages.config; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
